author: bobhebobhe
quote:
Its just not as new as i would like it to be. Yes its pretty but it feels less like gta than ever. It feels like everything was pumped into graphics and then innovative new design or expanding whats there is on the backburner.

What happened to gta just being a fun game? Now i cant just jack a random car anymore? Just boom on the spot? Now i have a reputation system that permanently follows my character? Sure this stuff is cool and realistic in concept but it moves away from being gamey in a bad way.
